thread:
maria: running into a flakey parsing error in sampleapp when using `mode: 'json'` + auth refresh. pops up only on long sessions where token refresh triggers.
aj: can you share the smallest repro snippet you have?
maria: here's the minimal TS case that reproduces ~50% of the time for me:
```ts
// app.ts
const r = await client.tool.call({ mode: 'json', input: { prompt: 'ping' } })
console.log('parsed:', r.parsed) // expected object, sometimes it's a string
```
lee: I hit something similar yesterday. Observed `r.parsed` is sometimes the serialized string of the JSON payload (e.g. '"{\"prompt\":\"ping\"}"') which then breaks consumer JSON.parse.
dan: probable cause: auth retry middleware re-runs serialization path for retries and double-stringifies when body is already a string. Only manifests for json-mode because we stringify earlier to carry a typed payload.
maria: logs show this sequence:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:01Z] prepare body -> {"prompt":"ping"}
[2026-03-17T09:12:01Z] send -> body stringified once
[2026-03-17T09:12:02Z] 401 -> refreshing token, retrying
[2026-03-17T09:12:02Z] auth-middleware -> JSON.stringify(body)
[2026-03-17T09:12:02Z] final body -> '"{\"prompt\":\"ping\"}"'
```
aj: that matches double-encode. For quick mitigation we added a guard in retry path: `if (typeof body === 'string') try{ JSON.parse(body) } catch(e){ /* it's raw string, leave it */ }` then only stringify if parse fails. Not perfect.
d an: I can take a proper fix: change auth wrapper to check content-type/metadata and avoid serializing if body is already serialized. Add unit tests for: object input, string input, Buffer, and streaming body. Also add cross-language sample to ensure parity (JS + Python SDK both behave the same).
maria: I'll paste a tiny Python snippet for the issue so QA can run both SDKs:
```py
# sample.py
resp = client.tool.call(mode='json', input={'prompt':'ping'})
print('parsed ->', resp.parsed)
```
sdk-bot: created RW-2376: "auth-retry double-encode with json mode (JS+Py parity)" assigned to @dan, labels: devex, p2
lee: thanks. can we also add an integration test that forces token expiry mid-request so retry path is exercised under CI? saves the 'it only happens locally' loop.
dan: good call. will add an e2e that injects a 401 at first attempt. I'll include a fixture of the sampleapp that Maria provided.
maria: thanks team. leaving the sampleapp link in the issue and I'll follow up with a short blurb for the onboarding guide reminding folks to disable auto-retry in early experiments. :thumbsup:
